item.title: Phantom Blade Zero
item.description:
Title: Phantom Blade Zero
Genre: Action , RPG
Developer: S-GAME Studio
Publisher: S-GAME Publishing
Release Date: Oct 28, 2026




About This Game

Framed for murdering his master, Soul suffers a devastating wound to the heart, leaving him just sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted, he roams the Wulin, determined to unravel a conspiracy that has ensnared the martial world.

Through rain and blood, kindness and vengeance, he embarks on a journey where love and hatred intertwine in search of a heart.

Explore the mysterious Phantom World, where shifting light and shadow conceal mysteries at every turn.

Memory Flowers, the Wulin and the Discordance, Transcension, the Lady of the Veil, Inanis' Dreamscape...

Every secret leads to another, and every corner hides a new story.

When one path ends, another begins. Hidden passages and intricate mechanisms await those who dare to explore.

In the Wulin, your weapon is your life.

Master over 30 primary weapons and more than 20 unique Phantom Edges, wrested from the hands of fallen foes.

Rooted in traditional martial arts, combat flows through seamless combos that are easy to learn yet rewarding to master. Only true masters will uncover the deadly intricacies within every technique.

Blades clash in showers of sparks. Dodge, deflect, counter, and strike in one seamless flow, where victory and defeat are decided in an instant.

Will the next turn leave the sands stained with blood, or lead you back from the brink of death?

The golden age of wuxia cinema collides with punk fantasy in Phantom Blade Zero.

Martial arts, cold steel, mechanical prosthetics, crumbling industrial ruins, traditional Chinese aesthetics, and modern rock music.

Together, they create the dark, unmistakable aesthetic of kungfupunk.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5 and cutting-edge motion capture technology, renowned martial arts choreographers from the golden age of wuxia cinema collaborated to bring authentic Chinese kungfu to life. Every strike and stance in Phantom Blade Zero is rooted in real martial techniques.

Experience the timeless allure of Chinese kungfu through breathtaking cinematic action.

item.title: Counter-Strike 2
item.description:
Title: Counter-Strike 2
Genre: Action , Free To Play
Developer: Valve
Publisher: Valve
Release Date: Aug 21, 2012




About This Game

For over two decades, Counter Strike has offered an elite competitive experience, one shaped by millions of players from across the globe. And now the next chapter in the CS story is about to begin. This is Counter Strike 2.

A free upgrade to CS:GO, Counter Strike 2 marks the largest technical leap in Counter Strike’s history. Built on the Source 2 engine, Counter Strike 2 is modernized with realistic physically-based rendering, state of the art networking, and upgraded Community Workshop tools.

In addition to the classic objective-focused gameplay that Counter Strike pioneered in 1999, Counter Strike 2 features:

  • All-new CS Ratings with the updated Premier mode

  • Global and Regional leaderboards

  • Upgraded and overhauled maps

  • Game-changing dynamic smoke grenades

  • Tick-rate-independent gameplay

  • Redesigned visual effects and audio

  • All items from CS:GO moving forward to CS2

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Includes intense violence and blood.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows® 10
    • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11-compatible with support for Shader Model 5.0
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 85 GB available space

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: Ubuntu 20.04
    • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD GCN+ or NVIDIA Kepler+ with up-to-date Vulkan drivers. Support for VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library highly recommended.
    • Storage: 85 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Highly recommended

item.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
item.description:
Title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
Genre: Action
Developer: Infinity Ward , Beenox , Digital Legends , Activision Shanghai , Raven Software , Treyarch , Sledgehammer Games , High Moon Studios
Publisher: Activision
Franchise: Call of Duty , Modern Warfare
Release Date: Oct 22, 2026




About This Game

War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control.

Modern Warfare® 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.

Campaign

Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory.

Fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad. Beyond the front lines, Operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price is operating outside the system he once served.

Multiplayer

Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement.

Large-scale maps return, combining vehicle and infantry combat across locations shaped by the campaign’s global conflict. From tight, close-quarters combat to open battlefield engagements, Multiplayer is designed to keep every fight fast, tactical and competitive.

DMZ

Loot, fight, negotiate, betray and extract with whatever you can carry. DMZ is the definitive Call of Duty® extraction experience, a living combat sandbox where every deployment is a new story. Deploy solo or with a squad into a volatile conflict zone as an off-the-books asset tasked with recovering advanced military technology left in the wake of war.

In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every extraction run into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Our team uses generative AI tools to help develop some in game assets.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit (latest update)*
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400 or Intel® Core™ i5-6600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 470, NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / 1060 or Intel® Arc™ A580
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 115 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
    • Additional Notes: *Trial, Beta or Insider versions of compatible Windows® operating systems may not be supported. SSD with 115 GB available space at launch.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 11 64 Bit (latest update)*
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600 or Intel® Core™ i7-8700K
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 6600XT, NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3060 or Intel® Arc™ B580
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 115 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
    • Additional Notes: *Trial, Beta or Insider versions of compatible Windows® operating systems may not be supported. SSD with 115 GB available space at launch.

item.title: AION 2
item.description:
Title: AION 2
Genre: Action , Adventure , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Free To Play
Developer: NC
Publisher: NC
Franchise: AION
Release Date: Oct 5, 2026




About This Game

AION 2 is now LIVE!

As a thank you to all Daevas, we are extending all Pre-Registration and Steam Wishlist reward items to every player who creates an account and logs in before maintenance begins on Dec 1, 11:30 PM PT / Dec 2, 8:30 AM CET. Simply log in and your rewards will be delivered to your in-game mail. Remember to claim them before the mail expires on Dec 8, 11:30 PM PT / Dec 9, 8:30 AM CET.

The sky is not the limit. It is the battlefield.

Built on Unreal Engine 5 across a world 36 times larger than the original AION, this is the only MMORPG built for aerial combat. Verticality is in the DNA of AION 2, and rewards players who can think, and fight, in 3 dimensions.

Every region, every battlefield, every encounter was designed with verticality as its axis. As a Daeva, flight is not a travel mechanic, it is how you fight, how you explore, and how you impose your will on the world. Gain altitude to gain advantage, and experience a scale of aerial combat unlike any other MMORPG.

Precision, timing, and positioning shape every battle. Chain skills seamlessly, customize your class to fit your playstyle, and adapt as encounters escalate. Every fight is a decision, not a rotation.

From solo instances to large-scale raids, AION 2 PvE is built around scale and variety. Over 200 dungeons span multiple formats: solo challenges, 5-player party content, and 10-player group dungeons. Seasonal challenges, competitive rankings, and open-world events keep the excitement high, and the Abyss ensures that PvE and faction war are never far apart.

Bring your vision to life with one of the most advanced character creation systems in an MMORPG. With over 200 customization options and countless outfits, mounts, and wings to collect, your character becomes a true expression of who you are.

The Shugo Festival brings a variety of mini-games to Atreia. Protect the Shugos from waves of enemies, race pets against other players, dodge lasers, and more. Earn unique rewards including wings, skins, pets, and décor!

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some in-game assets were created with the assistance of AI tools.
Arcana card designs and some icons use AI-generated assets.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 2600 / Intel® Core™ i5-10500
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended. When using FHD resolution in-game, set the graphics preset to Very Low to ensure compatibility.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 7 3700X / Intel® Core™ i7-11700
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 (8GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended. When using FHD resolution in-game, set the graphics preset to Low to ensure compatibility.

item.title: Aniimo
item.description:
Title: Aniimo
Genre: Action , Adventure , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Simulation , Strategy , Free To Play
Developer: Pawprint Studio
Publisher: Pawprint Studio
Release Date: Sep 15, 2026




About This Game

Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.

Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become stronger, here, every challenge is real and instantaneous!

Each Pathfinder now owns a personal RV on the vast continent of Idyll, parked at a campsite in this open world, where they can meet and interact with other players. When you return to Homeland with your RV, you can plant crops, build decorations, and freely arrange your space with Aniimo to transform the entire Homeland into a warm, fun, and interactive immersive paradise.

    Recommended:

    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 or better
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 40 GB available space
